en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.

New-product research and competitor observation: Researched ZUS Coffee content through user preferences, social feedback and competitor content, then distilled product messages to inform themes and topics.
Social content execution: Supported 50 Instagram posts through planning, shooting, editing, English copywriting, hashtags and asset organization.

Channel and content reviews: Supported online launches and FamilyMart communication with promotional assets, store details and posting schedules. Tracked data weekly and completed 15+ reviews to improve subsequent content; the account gained 11k+ followers as a shared result.

Market research and requirements: Researched teaching, lesson preparation and self-study needs among mainland and overseas university users. Managed communities and classified 100+ feedback items by type and frequency to inform product improvements and communication.

Standardized product materials: Built WeChat content from scratch, organizing AI education features, use cases and workflows into 30+ guides, FAQs, tutorials and scenarios. Core-feature usage increased 30% during the internship period.

Overseas cooperation: Supported Southeast Asia AI education cooperation by clarifying requirements and responsibilities and following up on agreement signing, material handoffs and coordination milestones.

University events and feedback: Coordinated demonstration and trial schedules, prepared demos, FAQs, teacher cases and course materials with product and business teams, tracked preparation and answered questions. Combined behavior and teacher/student feedback into over 10 suggestions for iterations and university pilots.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.

Customer insights and campaign planning: Used feedback and pricing surveys to identify usage scenarios, key needs and price acceptance, then developed product messages and campaign approaches. Designed online acquisition activities and supported technology-event materials, product introductions and on-site execution.
AI-assisted analysis: Used AI to help build a lightweight operations dashboard tracking visits, registrations, feature usage and user drop-off.

Product materials and copy: Organized standardized product introductions, tutorials, industry cases and FAQs across 100+ WeChat, Xiaohongshu and community posts. Screened finance and AI creators by audience and content performance and supported preparation and launch follow-up.

Promotion reviews: Tested titles, covers and content across Xiaohongshu, WeChat and event communities and adjusted spending using channel feedback and conversion data. Campaign registrations rose 50% versus the preceding week; first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively.

skills: Marketing postgraduate with working English and experience in customer research, product materials, brand communication and campaign execution.
Planning: user research, competitor analysis, product messaging, marketing copy, campaigns, channel reviews and cross-team collaboration.
AI: assisted dashboard building, feedback organization and data analysis; recurring tasks organized into SOPs, checklists and reusable templates.
Content: WeChat, Xiaohongshu and Instagram; Canva, CapCut, Figma (basic).
